I agree that AI image generation is not plagiarism per se. It depends on how those images are used and whether the original sources are attributed. But since the image is composed from statistical patterns gathered from training data, and these systems are incapable of identifying the sources…

Plagiarism isn’t just direct copying. It’s passing off somebody else’s work or ideas as one’s own. Generative AI works by recreating patterns in its—often unspecified—training data in response to a prompt. It’s plagiaristic insofar as it precludes attribution and acknowledgement of sources.
